profile: GUID-isolated native records; fixed test clock; authenticated composed GET

contributions.title: CEO commitments and risks

metrics.label: Completed commitments
metrics.definition: Current completed root work with a recorded completion timestamp in the selected interval. Worker outputs and approvals do not complete a company outcome.
metrics.coverage: Current authorized root-work cohort; up to 100 per lifecycle lane within the owning source window. Reopened or deleted historical outcomes are not reconstructed.

metrics.label: Historical blocker balance movement
metrics.definition: No complete historical blocker or commitment-balance snapshots exist. Current risks are shown as of refresh, including when reviewing an earlier week.
metrics.coverage: No complete historical blocker or commitment-balance snapshots exist. Current risks are shown as of refresh, including when reviewing an earlier week.

coverageGaps: No complete historical blocker or commitment-balance snapshots exist. Current risks are shown as of refresh, including when reviewing an earlier week.

contributions.title: Finance liquidity and obligations

metrics.label: Outstanding receivables due · SEK
metrics.definition: Current remaining booked operational obligations with due date in the full selected calendar week. Currency and receivable/payable direction are kept separate.
metrics.coverage: 1 source obligations; Finance operational calculation finance-operational/1.0. Current as of refresh, not a weekly actual cash flow.

metrics.label: Cash at weekly cutoff · SEK
metrics.definition: Owning Finance cash balances at 2026-10-01T11:59:59.9999999Z, compared at 2026-09-24T11:59:59.9999999Z; same account/currency cohort with retained prior snapshots. Posted cash movements after snapshots are included by Finance.
metrics.coverage: Recorded ledger calculation. Without a prior snapshot for every included account, comparison is unavailable. Imported/deleted/corrected history is not certified; opening evidence may underpin the selected balance.

commitments.title: P19-INVOICE · Weekly customer
commitments.summary: Current outstanding 130 SEK; review collection/payment through the owning workflow.

coverageGaps: Obligations are outstanding now, selected by the chosen week's due dates; past settlements and due-date revisions are not reconstructed. Cash is recorded ledger evidence, not live bank confirmation.

contributions.title: Sales movement and follow-ups

metrics.label: Recorded stage changes
metrics.definition: Count of recorded 'stage change' activities by occurrence time; not pipeline value.
metrics.coverage: Retained, non-deleted Sales activities only; absent older/imported events are not inferred. Combined prior/current source window is limited to 2,000 events.

metrics.label: Recorded customer activities
metrics.definition: Count of recorded Sales activities by occurrence time; not a count of deals or revenue.
metrics.coverage: Retained, non-deleted Sales activities only; absent older/imported events are not inferred. Combined prior/current source window is limited to 2,000 events.

metrics.label: Recorded follow-up executions
metrics.definition: Retained follow-up recommendations with an execution timestamp and completed or draft-prepared execution state. Draft preparation is not sending or customer receipt.
metrics.coverage: Current successful execution cohort; retried, deleted or imported history is not reconstructed. Up to 2,000 executions.

metrics.label: Pipeline balance movement
metrics.definition: Pipeline money balance movement is unavailable without complete dated deal-value/stage snapshots. Stage changes count recorded events, including repeated changes on the same deal.
metrics.coverage: Pipeline money balance movement is unavailable without complete dated deal-value/stage snapshots. Stage changes count recorded events, including repeated changes on the same deal.

commitments.title: Weekly proposal
commitments.summary: Current open opportunity: confirm the customer follow-up and expected close date. No historical status is inferred.

coverageGaps: Pipeline money balance movement is unavailable without complete dated deal-value/stage snapshots. Stage changes count recorded events, including repeated changes on the same deal.

contributions.title: Marketing delivery and launches

metrics.label: Recorded campaign starts
metrics.definition: Campaigns with a retained first start timestamp in the interval; scheduled launches are excluded.
metrics.coverage: Launches use the retained first start timestamp. Completed campaign activities are internal delivery, not provider-confirmed publication or attributed revenue. Deleted/imported history and subsequent relaunches are not reconstructed.

metrics.label: Completed campaign activities
metrics.definition: Internal campaign activity completion timestamps in the interval; not customer receipt or provider confirmation.
metrics.coverage: Launches use the retained first start timestamp. Completed campaign activities are internal delivery, not provider-confirmed publication or attributed revenue. Deleted/imported history and subsequent relaunches are not reconstructed.

metrics.label: Content due in selected week
metrics.definition: Current content brief deadlines in the full selected calendar week, including upcoming days; not completed delivery.
metrics.coverage: Current due schedule; prior schedule versions are not reconstructed.

commitments.title: Content deadline this week
commitments.summary: Current content deadline: open the exact brief and review readiness. Due content is not approved or delivered.

coverageGaps: Launches use the retained first start timestamp. Completed campaign activities are internal delivery, not provider-confirmed publication or attributed revenue. Deleted/imported history and subsequent relaunches are not reconstructed.

contributions.title: Support movement and service targets

metrics.label: Cases opened
metrics.definition: Cases created in the interval, irrespective of current resolution state.
metrics.coverage: Recorded case creations and lifecycle events only; imported cases may lack full lifecycle history. Up to 2,000 cases/events per source window.

metrics.label: Recorded resolutions
metrics.definition: Count of stored resolved events in the interval, including repeated events for one case. A current status does not establish historical movement.
metrics.coverage: Recorded case creations and lifecycle events only; imported cases may lack full lifecycle history. Up to 2,000 cases/events per source window.

metrics.label: Recorded reopenings
metrics.definition: Count of stored reopened events in the interval, including repeated events for one case. A current status does not establish historical movement.
metrics.coverage: Recorded case creations and lifecycle events only; imported cases may lack full lifecycle history. Up to 2,000 cases/events per source window.

metrics.label: First response SLA
metrics.definition: Cases whose stored first-response deadline falls in the interval. On-time recorded replies / all due targets; unanswered overdue cases remain in the denominator.
metrics.coverage: 2 eligible due targets; prior 0. Stored business-calendar deadlines are reused; target/calendar changes are not reconstructed.

metrics.label: Backlog balance movement
metrics.definition: Complete historic lifecycle coverage is not certified; current case statuses cannot reconstruct prior backlog balances.
metrics.coverage: Complete historic lifecycle coverage is not certified; current case statuses cannot reconstruct prior backlog balances.

commitments.title: P19-2: Unanswered overdue
commitments.summary: Current unresolved case: review response or escalation; risk observed now.

commitments.title: P19-1: On-time reply
commitments.summary: Current unresolved case: review response or escalation; risk observed now.

commitments.title: P19-3: Future target
commitments.summary: Current unresolved case: review response or escalation; risk observed now.

coverageGaps: Historical backlog balances and calendar/target revisions are unavailable; recorded resolutions/reopenings are event counts, not net backlog movement.
Sparse or missing SLA samples are unavailable, not zero performance.

observed.calendarMeaning: Monday–Sunday calendar weeks in W. Europe Standard Time; independent of fiscal-year boundaries. Activity uses [start, cutoff); balances use their disclosed observation/cutoff. Current risks are observed now, not reconstructed past states.
